title: Pokémon Adventures
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A long-running manga that retells each Pokémon game generation with its own young trainers, starting with Red, Green and Blue in Kanto. In each arc the trainers raise and battle Pokémon while stopping criminal groups such as Team Rocket, Team Galactic and Team Plasma, who try to exploit Legendary Pokémon. It is grittier than the anime, with heroes kidnapped, petrified or hurt.
life_message: Courage, friendship and respect for creatures, joined with growing up, let ordinary kids stand against people who exploit nature for power.
